target_policy: Development labels only; no holdout scoring. Full train labels used only for final fit.
context_policy: Transductive unlabeled full train+test roster: group size, peer attributes, unanimous imputation. No target propagation.
gate: Screen accuracy >0.83 and improvement >=0.001; both new split seeds improve; confirmation mean accuracy >0.83 and mean gain >=0.001. Candidate frozen before confirmation. User approval required before online submission.
smoothing_policy: One fixed epsilon=.1, targets .05/.95; CrossEntropy global CatBoost with same v34 features/hyperparameters. Matched CrossEntropy hard-label control epsilon0 plus original v6/v34. Before original spatial probability blend, map q to clip((q-.05)/.9,1e-6,1-1e-6); theoretical inverse of soft conditional expectation, not a claim of empirically calibrated probabilities. Original spatial expert still trains on hard outertrain labels, no validation tuning, no smoothing-strength search.
